sloka: अमोघशापैः शप्तस्तु दत्तो ऽस्य मुनिभिः पुरा ।न वेत्ता हि बलं येन बली सन्निरिमर्दनः ।। ७.३५.१६ ॥
transliteration: amoghaśāpaiḥ śaptastu datto 'sya munibhiḥ purā ।na vettā hi balaṁ yena balī sannirimardanaḥ ।। 7.35.16 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, he was formerly cursed by sages with unfailing curses, by which, though he is strong and a destroyer of foes, he does not know his own strength.
translations.hindi: जयन्त को घेर कर जो देवसेना आयी थी, वह्‌ मेघनाद के बाणों से पीड़ित हो गयो और बहुप्रकार से विकल हो उठी
